cards.title: Defaults
cards.body: Give a parameter a default with `=`. When the caller leaves it out, the default is used.

cards.title: Returning text
cards.body: A function can build a string, often between backticks, and return it.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The call passes "!", so it replaces the default "*".

exercise.prompt: Finish `greet(name, greeting = "Hello")` so it returns `<greeting>, <name>!`. The code below prints `greet(name)` and then `greet(name, "Welcome")`.

hiddenTests.expectedOutput:
Hello, Mary Jane!
Welcome, Mary Jane!
